summary: Reviewed the base-to-head change: app hosts are registered with service bindings, all app HTML flows through the shared footer rewriter, which appends a styled seven-character commit link and omits the question mark. No blocking correctness defect was found.

evidence: `src/worker.ts` lines 30-53 and 130-145 register the apex, every app Worker and the VPS repositories, then forward Worker requests through the shared footer middleware.
`src/worker.ts` lines 237-316 append a muted monospace commit link to an existing footer or create a footer, link to the GitHub commit, and skip existing badges and the question mark.

`tests/app-revision-routing.test.ts` and `tests/app-revision.test.ts` cover footer injection for all twelve app Workers and the four VPS apps, including exact commit links, styles, safe fallback and no duplicate badge.
When an app supplies `X-App-Revision` and `X-App-Repository` the footer uses that exact deployed SHA; otherwise it uses the repository default-branch HEAD and labels the deployment as not reported.
